pages.title: Ainda falta fechar

pages.layout: Beren alone points with one hand at a wooden support model on workbench, other hand at belt. Left knee brace visible. High stone wall above head.

lines.text: A escora não pode empurrar a carga para o selo.

pages.layout: Adult small Nima alone stands on solid work platform turning a removable small bronze latch with two gloved hands, tools laid separately, mature face below35percent.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Se a pressão subir demais, podemos retirar as metades.

pages.scene: Tovo alone at courtyard winch, injured shoulder supported by plain sling; he points with GOOD hand to operating card while bad arm stays inside sling. No lifting.
pages.layout: Tovo alone at courtyard winch, injured shoulder supported by plain sling; he points with GOOD hand to operating card while bad arm stays inside sling. No lifting.

lines.text: Eu coordeno. O peso fica com a talha.

pages.layout: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT inspect thin airflow ribbon by EXIT arch. Both arms simple, no crossed limbs. Sere bow slung, silver single braid.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Aviso antes de corrigir o ar.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: E mantemos a saída desocupada.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Posso ajudar com o calor, se faltar luz.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Só dentro do limite combinado. A reserva comum vem primeiro.

pages.scene: Still-life two protected torches, ordinary lantern, separate folded operating card and small glass cup with wick on wooden bench. No hands or people.
pages.layout: Still-life two protected torches, ordinary lantern, separate folded operating card and small glass cup with wick on wooden bench. No hands or people.

pages.layout: Ilyan alone writing letter at table by night lantern, serious clean-shaven face and long wavy hair, other hand holds page flat, spare wall above.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Como contar esperança e mais uma espera na mesma carta?

pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT seated at desk, Nima RIGHT on raised workseat, adult gnome significantly smaller. Nima leaves letter untouched and talks with hands on knees.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Queria achar a frase certa.

lines.text: Bram conheceu Mira. Pode receber uma verdade incompleta.

pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT and Runa RIGHT on quiet courtyard bench at night, two hands resting separately on bench, look at each other with exhausted affection. No kissing yet.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Quero correr atrás da pista.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Eu sei. Amanhã ainda temos pessoas para trazer de volta.

pages.layout: Wide nighttime city of Talveira, intact blue glass bridge over canal, quiet houses and small closed external service gate far to one side. No people, portals or ruin.
pages.narration: A carta ficou guardada. A janela externa continuava aberta; o selo inferior, fechado.

pages.layout: Sere alone at dawn evacuation street examines exit ribbon, bow on back, hands hold notebook at waist, street clear behind her.

pages.layout: Caio alone at dry stairs, one palm low controls weak existing upward airflow, other points at real wall ribbon. No vortex.

lines.text: Há corrente para levar o pó. Não prometo uma rajada estável.

pages.layout: Eda alone at lower landing reads TWO separate cards above a pressure gauge, holds one pencil and notebook. No portraits on cards.

pages.layout: Small adult Nima alone on securely bolted work platform inserts ONE bronze halfplate in shallow rectangular exterior niche beside thick bluewater glass; exactly two hands on plate. No human sized gnome.
pages.narration: A peça entrava pelo lado de fora. O lacre do selo principal não era tocado.

pages.layout: Close eerie old frosted glass showing only indistinct SALT body mass behind narrow slit, bronze halfplate outside, no human face, no human mouths or ghosts. No creature exits.

lines.text: Segurar. O comando escrito é segurar, não soltar.

pages.layout: Tovo alone surface winch injured arm in sling, reads ONE attached card and signals with good hand, rope carries load, no amplified muscles.

lines.text: Mantenham. A ordem falsa veio da parede.

pages.layout: Liria alone on separate UPPER geological landing measures hairline porous stone crack with caliper; two tight braids chin scar. No Runa or other figures.

lines.text: A escora precisa entrar antes da segunda metade.

pages.layout: Runa alone on LOWER inspection landing, clean water vial at belt, her LEFT floral arm holds narrow measuring rod, right hand points at rising level behind thick glass. Right arm unmarked.

lines.text: O nível está subindo. Precisamos do desvio autorizado.

pages.layout: Nima alone on low safe work platform withdraws both hands from SECOND bronze halfplate resting on shelf, firstplate fixed; she waits, no impossible reach.

pages.layout: Beren alone kneels at stone support, left knee brace, uses TWO hands to position a short wooden support wedge, no extra arm or huge beams.
pages.narration: O apoio recebeu a escora antes de outra mudança de pressão.

pages.layout: Eda alone holds permit card beside closed brass MECHANICAL water valve at lower landing; local operator remains off frame. No magical valve turning.

lines.text: A responsável local autorizou a abertura pelo tempo marcado.

pages.layout: Runa alone carefully guides a SMALL sheet of existing released clean water along narrow authorized trough. One left tattooed hand palm open, other hand lowered. No water from nothing, no flooding.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A pressão caiu. Mantenham a leitura.

pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Eda RIGHT at lower landing with pressure gauge and ordinary valve, hands simple, Runa stops with palm at waist; Eda reads permit.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Eda RIGHT at lower landing with pressure gauge and ordinary valve, hands simple, Runa stops with palm at waist; Eda reads permit.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Minha medida não autoriza gastar a cisterna.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Vou consultar a responsável antes de ampliar o desvio.

pages.title: Meio giro
pages.scene: Landscape close of ordinary brass valve at a HALF TURN stop mark and small hourglass, trough water passing, no hands people or readable symbols.
pages.layout: Landscape close of ordinary brass valve at a HALF TURN stop mark and small hourglass, trough water passing, no hands people or readable symbols.

pages.layout: Liria alone upper landing reads caliper at thin crack and writes measurement on card. No reconciliation, focused hostile face.

lines.text: O valor parou de crescer. Enviem o número a Eda.

pages.layout: Nima alone small adult on secure platform starts SECOND bronze halfplate toward rectangular exterior niche. Two hands visible supporting same smallpiece. Warm oil lantern visible in bracket.

lines.text: As duas condições conferem. Vou retomar.

pages.layout: Close ordinary oil lantern extinguished by changed airflow, wick smoking slightly, bronze latch blurred beyond, bluewater glass wall. No hands or silhouettes.

lines.text: As tochas cairiam nesta rajada. Esperem na curva.

pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT seated low, elderly Oru RIGHT small adult stands beside protected glass cup with wick. Oru holds simple thermometer near Ilyan single extended hand; Ilyan other hand rests knee. Precisely four hands total.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT seated low, elderly Oru RIGHT small adult stands beside protected glass cup with wick. Oru holds simple thermometer near Ilyan single extended hand; Ilyan other hand rests knee. Precisely four hands total.

lines.text: Um pavio, alguns batimentos. Você pode recusar.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Só para essa luz. Se eu tremer, paramos.

pages.layout: Ilyan alone focused close medium, one open palm beneath protected glass wick cup, SMALL flame begins overwick only; his other arm lowered. No extra hands, no body engulfed in fire. Faceupper35percent below clear stonearch.

pages.layout: Nima alone turns small bronze latch beside second halfplate under SMALL protected wick light in wallbracket, both her hands clearly on separate latch edges, matureface. No floating human hand in frame.

lines.text: Marca visível. Trava encaixada.

pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT and Oru RIGHT ascend dry stairs toward daylight. Ilyan wraps both hands INSIDE one wool cloth so fingers hidden, Oru points UP with one hand, other carries notebook. No carrying human on back or lifting.

lines.text: A chama acabou. Venha aquecer as mãos.

pages.layout: Landscape close external bronze plate in TWO joined halves, fixed support wedge and little mechanical pressure bell. Glass remains intact behind, no creature outside, no portal.

pages.layout: Ysra alone inspects numbered SEALED lower-route register and separate exterior pressure reading at surface desk, no opening mainseal; exact gold eyes templetwigs.

pages.layout: Wide Talveira street with a FEW small distant anonymous adult residents walking cautiously home, intact blueglassbridge inbackground, no crowd of duplicated protagonists.

pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT seated with heavy blanket fully over clothed shoulders andlap, holds broth mug with2hands; small Oru RIGHT on high stool writes pulse temperature in notebook. Facesbelow35percent.

lines.text: Acendi o pavio e agora não consigo aquecer os pés.

lines.text: Registre as duas coisas. O frio também é parte da técnica.

pages.layout: Ysra alone at courtyard rail shows a small boundary rope and observes external bell from safe distance; residents off frame.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Só a retirada de objetos. A faixa junto à grade continua fechada.

pages.layout: Nima adult small alone on work platform writes a compact maintenance notebook beside removable bronze model, tools secure and legs complete.

lines.text: O caderno precisa servir mesmo quando eu não estiver na cidade.

pages.layout: Landscape close final maintenance page with an abstract corrected dimension and TWO distinct signature strokes, brass caliper and nib. No portraits or hands.

pages.layout: Eda alone sorts three separate report bundles on desk, first exteriorwindow, second sealedroute, third evidenceMira abstract diagrams, no readabletext.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Falha externa, selo intacto, descoberta de Mira. Cada prova no seu lugar.

pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT and Ysra RIGHT at archivecounter. Ysra offers sealed copy, originalroutefile remains closed behindcounter. Simple hands at waist, clear upperwall.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Queria levar o desenho inteiro.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Consulta e cópia lacrada. A rota precisa dos guardiões.

pages.title: Uma folha para os moradores

pages.layout: Eda alone writes a simple PUBLIC notice at table with a little drawing of upperstreet and closedgate, no complex magical jargon or generatedletters.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Por onde buscar água e quem chamar se o sino tocar.

pages.layout: Tovo LEFT seated injured arm in sling, Oru RIGHT small elderlyadult stands bylowtable, points at small benchpulley, no strength demonstration.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Então fico sem levantar panelas por semanas?

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Pode organizar o turno. O ombro precisa de carga leve.

pages.title: Fora do turno
pages.scene: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT walk by publicwateredge atlamplight holding ONE pair of hands, outer arms lowered, greensilverbraid vs shortauburn hair clear. Fullyclothed sweet adultcouple.
pages.layout: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT walk by publicwateredge atlamplight holding ONE pair of hands, outer arms lowered, greensilverbraid vs shortauburn hair clear. Fullyclothed sweet adultcouple.

lines.text: Tive medo de ouvir minha voz sair da grade.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Procurei sua mão. Eu também tive.

pages.scene: Liria LEFT and Runa RIGHT stand well APART in archive doorway, angry, arms resting separately, no smiles friendship or touch. Upperstonearch free. Exactlytwofigures.
pages.layout: Liria LEFT and Runa RIGHT stand well APART in archive doorway, angry, arms resting separately, no smiles friendship or touch. Upperstonearch free. Exactlytwofigures.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: O desvio quase fez a peça escorregar.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Sua escora sozinha teria aumentado a pressão.

pages.scene: Oru alone small elderlyadult on lowstep inarchivecorridor, stern face gold copper glasses, holds blankreport atwaist. Rivals off frame.
pages.layout: Oru alone small elderlyadult on lowstep inarchivecorridor, stern face gold copper glasses, holds blankreport atwaist. Rivals off frame.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Escrevam as objeções. Não vou declarar uma vencedora.

pages.layout: Ilyan alone fullyclothed at guesthousebench with bowl onsidetable, one hand trembles atwaist other rests knee, droppedspoon on floor below, no thirdhand.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A mão está quente. O tremor ainda não foi embora.

pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT and Runa RIGHT seated on SAME quiet guesthousebench, bothfullyclothed, clean spoon andwarm bowl on smalltable. Runa calmly listens, simplehands onlap.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Você vai precisar me vigiar em toda parte?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Podemos cuidar um do outro sem decidir pelo outro.

pages.title: Contar quando vier o frio
pages.scene: Same two adults Ilyan LEFT Runa RIGHT onbench gently hold ONE pair of hands overbench, otherhands resting separately. Affectionate eyecontact, no kiss yet, no entangled fingers.
pages.layout: Same two adults Ilyan LEFT Runa RIGHT onbench gently hold ONE pair of hands overbench, otherhands resting separately. Affectionate eyecontact, no kiss yet, no entangled fingers.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Prometo contar quando o frio começar.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: É isso que quero ouvir de você.

pages.title: Um beijo pedido
pages.scene: Two ADULTS Ilyan18 LEFT and Runa18 RIGHT share a tender CLOSED-MOUTH kiss, fully dressed in canonical outfits seated sidebyside, simple two arms each lowered or restingbench. Exact longwavyhair vs straightbangs septum LEFTtattoo. No tongues or sexualpose. Natural sparewall top.
pages.layout: Two ADULTS Ilyan18 LEFT and Runa18 RIGHT share a tender CLOSED-MOUTH kiss, fully dressed in canonical outfits seated sidebyside, simple two arms each lowered or restingbench. Exact longwavyhair vs straightbangs septum LEFTtattoo. No tongues or sexualpose. Natural sparewall top.

pages.layout: Two fullyclothed adults Ilyan and Runa gently rest foreheads together AFTER kiss, hands onownknees, warmquiet lamplitbench, no extra faces.

lines.text: Vou sentir falta deste silêncio na Casa.

lines.text: Vamos procurar outros. Também em dias tranquilos.

pages.scene: ExactlyTHREE adults fullyclothed: Ilyan seated LEFT, Runa seatedCENTER, adultgnome Nima90cm standingRIGHT with notebook. They make space onbench ratherthan excludeher. Correctsmallscale, hands simpleandseparate.

pages.narration: Quando Nima chegou, abriram espaço. O carinho não precisava virar segredo.

pages.title: Posso ficar?
pages.scene: Runa human LEFT seated onnormalchair, Nima adultgnome RIGHT onraised secureworkplatform, lens safely in tray, facelevel similar dueplatform. Fullyclothed quietday workshop.
pages.layout: Runa human LEFT seated onnormalchair, Nima adultgnome RIGHT onraised secureworkplatform, lens safely in tray, facelevel similar dueplatform. Fullyclothed quietday workshop.

lines.text: Posso ficar um pouco?

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Sente aqui. Hoje até o carvão da forja me faz falta.

pages.layout: Nima alone mature adultgnome sits onraisedworkstool beside repaired tinyhandpump model, tells story proudly, bothhands onstool no floatingtools.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Consertei a bomba da praça sem os dois por perto.

pages.narration: Runa pediu uma lembrança que ainda não conhecia. Nima contou uma conquista sua.

pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Nima RIGHT seated atworkbench with raisedgnomeseat, fullyclothed, sincere eyecontact, lensguardedtray and hands separately ontable.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Nima RIGHT seated atworkbench with raisedgnomeseat, fullyclothed, sincere eyecontact, lensguardedtray and hands separately ontable.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Nosso carinho depende só de Ilyan?

lines.speaker: Nima
